svg.title: Architecture Sandbox — Production architecture
svg.desc: Cloudflare Workers Static Assets delivers the React frontend to the browser. The browser sends conversations and diagrams to a Rust API on Cloud Run, which calls Gemini and returns responses and evaluations. Secret Manager injects the API key into the server. Diagrams, conversations, and evaluations are saved as local JSON files. Auxiliary flows show sharing through TinyURL and X, and deployment from GitHub Actions.
svg.text: Design in the browser. Call Gemini through a Rust API on Cloud Run.
